Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the walkthrough last week — the team loved the latency and multi-region routing demo. We are preparing a 6-month enterprise pilot centered on clinical triage and internal knowledge search.

Thanks for the thoughtful framing. I will authorize a concession up to 30% off Hosted API usage for the pilot, contingent on the following binding conditions:

1) Signed MOU with explicit 6-month pilot scope and a conversion clause to a 12-month commitment post-pilot.
2) 80% of the 12-month commitment prepayment collected before pilot start (or within 30 days of MOU signature).
3) Usage floor: if post-pilot conversion does not meet the agreed committed usage, Healthspan will remain liable for the agreed minimum or reimburse the concession (clawback).
4) No dedicated capacity or SLA guarantees beyond standard enterprise SLA without a separate Dedicated offer addendum and pricing.

Legal: Rachel, please kick this to Legal and Deal Desk to bake in the conversion clause and clawback. Priyom: please model the net unit economics under the 30% concession so we have a final margin table for finance.

Approve and move quickly — procurement deadline 06/30 is tight. Marcus
